title: 修复金额计算的提前舍入
issue:
Synthetic development fixture, hand-authored for PatchForge; not an external benchmark.

Repair invoice_total(lines, discount="0", tax="0"). lines is a list of (unit_price, quantity) pairs; unit_price, discount and tax are finite decimal strings and quantity is a nonnegative integer. Sum exact unit_price * quantity products, then apply the fractional discount, then fractional tax: subtotal * (1-discount) * (1+tax). Round exactly once, at the final result, to Decimal("0.01") using ROUND_HALF_UP. Return a Decimal, including Decimal("0.00") for empty lines. Reject negative prices/quantities, discount outside [0,1], or negative tax with ValueError. Do not use binary floating point. The current code rounds each line before accumulating and overcharges small line items.
